column7: validateGroupJoinRoles skipped a group role on ANY GetRole error, so a transient storage fault skipped that role's grant ceiling and AddUserToGroup let a project_viewer join an admin-conferring group. It now skips only a positive not-found (TestAddUserToGroup_DeletedGroupRoleStillSkipped) and refuses with ErrStorageReadUnavailable otherwise. Siblings fixed the same way: the group-join SoD permission set (TestRequireGroupJoinNoSoDViolation_GetRoleFaultFailsClosed), requireInvitationGrantScopesValid (TestRequireInvitationGrantScopesValid_GetRoleByNameFaultFailsClosed), ListPendingInvitationsOutsideAssignableScope. Class guard: internal/core/guards TestNoRoleReadErrorSkippedAsGone.
